author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Mark my words
Amazon blocking perplexity and muse AI agents helping the users to shop marks the downfall of the online retail giant.
It will be a case study in MBA school a decade from now, citing it the dumbest short sighted business decision at the dawn of AI era.
If AI can't see it, it doesn't exist. It is as dumb as the equivalent of blocking Google search indexing your website at the dawn of the internet era.
